verdict.rationale: PCI scope reduction is a fair question for a payments platform. The evidence shows in-person acceptance (Tap to Pay, Mobile Payments SDK, Square hardware) and a tokenized card-on-file sourceId. None of it says card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers, mentions PCI scope or certification, or offers guidance on the developer's remaining compliance obligations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations
